trajectory_record.statement: No true MCTS or evolutionary trajectory was run. The portfolio is a transparent route comparison constrained by the frozen Survey evidence.

competitive_ideas.name: Cross-sectional skeletal-maturity catalogue
competitive_ideas.mechanism: Describe associations of age, bone age, and one-time imaging state.
competitive_ideas.rejection_reason: Does not establish future predictive value or solve the longitudinal alignment gap.

competitive_ideas.name: Longitudinal Growth-Plate Closure Readiness Atlas
competitive_ideas.mechanism: Jointly model repeated height velocity, MRI growth-plate features, pubertal endocrine state, and optional inherited features; evaluate interval-censored closure and sustained low-growth probability.
competitive_ideas.strength: Directly tests incremental prediction, calibration, and transportability without intervention.

competitive_ideas.name: Direct endocrine perturbation and tissue sampling
competitive_ideas.mechanism: Manipulate hormone exposure and assay growth-plate tissue.
competitive_ideas.rejection_reason: Inappropriate initial design for healthy minors; poor feasibility and unacceptable intervention risk.

high_risk_ideas.name: Universal genetic closure clock
high_risk_ideas.risk: Conflates polygenic adult-height association with deterministic individual closure timing and would amplify ancestry and interpretation bias.

selected_primary_idea.title: Longitudinal Growth-Plate Closure Readiness Atlas
selected_primary_idea.research_object: Repeated participant-level longitudinal growth trajectories with noninvasive growth-plate imaging and developmental covariates.
selected_primary_idea.central_hypothesis: A preregistered multimodal model will improve held-out calibration and proper scoring for sustained growth cessation beyond a chronological-age-plus-bone-age baseline.
selected_primary_idea.proposed_relation: Growth-plate MRI features and puberty-related endocrine measures are candidate predictors of residual longitudinal growth; inherited features are evaluated only with ancestry-aware controls. The relation is predictive, not a causal intervention effect.
falsification_conditions: The baseline matches or exceeds the multimodal model on held-out primary scores.
The multimodal model fails overall or subgroup calibration gates.
Incremental benefit disappears at an external site or later recruitment wave.
Signal is dependent on leakage, missingness artifacts, or a single feature family.
selected_primary_idea.feasibility_path: Recruit or reuse an ethically approved longitudinal pediatric cohort; acquire research MRI without ionizing radiation; collect serial anthropometry and limited clinically appropriate blood samples; separate training, temporal validation, and external-site evaluation.
